title: Graduate civil or environmental engineer - expression of interest (Kew)
content_text: Mackenzie Environmental career opportunities page (12/79-83 High St Kew VIC 3101). Specialist geoenvironmental / civil engineering consultancy focused on the Victorian landfill industry. We are always on the lookout for outstanding experienced engineers, graduates or engineering students. We are actively recruiting graduates to start asap, so please send your CVs to enquiries@mackenviro.com.au. Separately listed Current Opportunity: Civil Designer/Drafter/3D Modeller for experienced Civil 3D designers on landfill and extractive projects (mentoring juniors); that stream is not this EOI. Phone 03 9006 0125.
apply_instructions: Send CV to enquiries@mackenviro.com.au (actively recruiting graduates to start asap).
